note: Reference-stack numbers (diffusers Cosmos3OmniPipeline called directly). NOT through the Repercep seam - models/cosmos3.py's pipeline half is still Phase 1, so these do not belong in CONTROL_LOOP_BENCH.md.

workload.conditioning: synthetic 640x540 flat canvas (real 3-camera DROID composite not yet wired - see caveats)

forward_dynamics_gate.verdict: WORKS on the post-trained Policy-DROID checkpoint
forward_dynamics_gate.note: Fed a policy call's own predicted (16,10) chunk back as raw_actions. Confirms models/cosmos3.py can keep step_mode=forward_dynamics, so step() stays action-conditioned; and confirms the _Cosmos3Pipeline Protocol's documented 'actions_norm is None in fd mode'.

levers_ladder_warm.drift_definition: deviation of the predicted (16,10) action chunk from the 480p/30-step baseline, in the model's normalized [-1,1] space. A proxy for 'how much does cutting compute change the decision' -- NOT a quality metric. No success-rate harness was run; RoboLab is the missing piece.
levers_ladder_warm.discarded_artifact: A first pass computed speedups against a COLD first-in-process baseline (15336.4 ms), yielding a 4.25x 'speedup' for the 30-step row against its own configuration. Every speedup in that pass was inflated ~4.25x. Recomputed here against the warm 3611.8 ms reference.

cold_start_is_per_shape.finding: MIOpen autotune is paid per tensor shape, not only per process. Changing num_inference_steps costs nothing extra (iteration count, not shape); changing resolution_tier does.
cold_start_is_per_shape.discarded_artifact: A single cold 256p run measured 49791.4 ms and read as '256p is 13.8x SLOWER than 480p'. It was autotune for an unseen shape. Warm 256p is 1834.8 ms -- nearly 2x FASTER than 480p. The sign of the conclusion was wrong, not just the magnitude.
cold_start_is_per_shape.implication: A serving fleet must pre-warm every (resolution, batch) shape it intends to serve, not merely load weights.

batching_gate.verdict: NOT MEASURABLE - stock interface exposes no candidate-batching axis
batching_gate.evidence: Cosmos3OmniPipeline.__call__ has no num_videos_per_prompt/num_images_per_prompt parameter; CosmosActionCondition carries a single image. Passing prompt=[p]*N returned 1 candidate with identical wall time (3595-3610 ms) and identical peak HBM (33.59 GiB) at N=1,2,4,8 - the batch was silently ignored.
batching_gate.discarded_artifact: A naive batched_ms/N reading of that run yields a fake 2.01x/4.00x/8.01x 'speedup' at N=2/4/8. It is an unchanged runtime divided by N and measures nothing. Recorded here so it is never re-derived and mistaken for a result.
